info.title: CarePulse 24x7 IoT Remote Health Monitoring Platform API
info.description: Multi-tenant wearable ingestion, configurable wellness rules engine, P1-P4 alerting & escalation, DPDP Act 2023 consent management, immutable hash-chained audit log, 24x7 Caregiver Console, and Overseas Family Mobile App API.

get.summary: Platform health, UK region residency, TLS/AES-256 status, and audit chain integrity
Fetch Care Centre residents, active/historical alerts, device fleet, RBAC matrix, and audit log snapshot
Fetch resident profile, raw telemetry stream, 1m/5m/1h roll-ups, and FHIR R4 / ABDM consent artefacts (Audited)

patch.summary: Update per-patient wellness & geofence thresholds at runtime without deployment (Audited)
Update or withdraw DPDP Act 2023 resident consent (immediately redacting Family App view when withdrawn)

post.summary: Assign, Acknowledge, Escalate, or Close an alert with mandatory caregiver disposition notes
HTTPS wearable telemetry & event ingestion endpoint (per-device HMAC/X.509 auth, rate-limited, deduplicated)

400.description: Rejected by auth, rate-limit, or validation

post.summary: Interactive Virtual Wearable Band simulator ingestion endpoint
Execute 5,000-band load & SLA simulation returning p50/p95/p99 latencies and zero-silent-loss verification
Request 6-digit OTP for international E.164 mobile number (+1, +44, +91, +61, +65)
Verify international OTP code for Family Mobile App

get.summary: Fetch calm, consent-limited 'Is my parent OK?' mobile view with alert disposition history

post.summary: Bulk import pilot care-centre residents from CSV and auto-provision wearable bands
